notes:
Customer profile: builds an IDE/PR assistant used by developer teams at mid-to-large enterprises. Primary value prop: reduce time-to-merge with accurate diff summaries + prioritised reviewer suggestions.

Shorthand from calls:
- Wants low-latency streaming for inline suggestions (target: 30-50ms token latency for small completions).
- Emphasis on model/version pinning: "we need deterministic outputs tied to release trains".
- Reranking use-case: ingest CI diffs, derive top-3 putative reviewer comments; must allow custom reranker weights per repo.
- Data residency: logs/inputs from enterprise customers must not leave EU for EU customers.
- Cost sensitivity: developer-facing pricing needs to be predictable; exploring Dedicated for heavy indexing jobs and Hosted for low-friction onboarding.

Customer quotes: "When a PR gets spammy, we want the assistant to highlight the 2-3 risky changes, not noise."

Actionable notes: include sample repo (github.com/diffpilot/example-monorepo) for eval; they will share a ~1500-PR prompt set for quality checks. SE should prepare a quantization + batching recommendation for the POC to hit latency + cost targets.
